title: Global Well-posedness and Regularity of the Dynamical Prandtl Equation
summary: In this paper, we study the dynamical Prandtl equation, which plays an important role in the study of the vanishing viscosity limit of the Navier--Stokes equations. Our focus is on the (Sobolev) well-posedness regime, where the given data satisfy a crucial monotonicity condition. In this case, local classical solutions have been constructed in the pioneering works of Oleinik \cite{O68,OS99}. More recently, global weak solutions were obtained in \cite{XZ04} by Xin and Zhang, and in \cite{XZZ24} by Xin, Zhang, and Zhao, where the uniqueness and interior H"older estimates of the solutions were…
